home.placeholder: Foundations in place. Schedule and booking land in P1.
home.placeholder_web: Foundations in place. The back office lands in P1.
design_system.title: Design system
design_system.intro: The same tokens as the mobile app, exposed as CSS variables. Switch your system theme to see the dark scheme.
language.label: Language
waitlist.position_one: You're #{position} on the waitlist. We'll ping you as soon as a spot opens.
waitlist.position_other: You're #{position} on the waitlist, out of {total} people waiting.
auth.welcome_body: Book your classes, track your performance, take your box anywhere.
auth.welcome_link_unrecognised_body: You can carry on and sign in as usual.
auth.email_hint: We send you a six-digit code. No password to remember.
auth.code_rejected: Wrong or expired code. Ask for a new one.
auth.too_many_requests: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
profile.title: Your profile
profile.intro: Your first name appears on your box's attendance sheet.
profile.last_name_hint: Optional. Other members only ever see the initial.
consents.title: Your agreements
consents.intro: Two are required, two are yours to choose. Each one can be withdrawn as easily as it is given.
consents.terms: I accept the terms of service
consents.privacy: I have read the privacy policy
consents.privacy_description: Required. It sets out what is collected, and why.
consents.push_description: Class reminders, a waitlist spot opening up. Declining interrupts nothing.
consents.leaderboard_description: Your first name and scores visible to members of your box.
consents.required_missing: The first two agreements are required to continue.
home.no_box_description: Open the invitation link your box sent you to join it.
login.title: Box back office
login.intro: Sign in to administer your box.
login.hint: We send you a sign-in link. No password to remember.
login.sent_body: Open the message sent to {email} from this browser: the link only works in the one that asked for it.
login.error_link: This link is no longer valid. Ask for a new one.
login.error_expired: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
shell.unknown_box_body: This address matches none of your boxes. Check the link, or ask whoever administers it for access.
shell.staff_only_body: The back office is for owners and managers. Your member space is in the mobile app.
shell.not_configured_body: The file apps/web/.env.local does not exist. See the README section on environment variables.
shell.coming_soon_body: The back office shell is in place. Settings, staff and members land with P1-001.
settings.title: Box settings
settings.intro: What the box offers, when it is open, and how members book.
settings.error_invalid: Check the fields: one of the values will not do.
settings.error_overlap: This slot overlaps another one on the same day.
settings.identity_help: The name, web address and time zone of the box.
settings.identity_owner_only: Only the owner edits the box identity. Opening hours, rooms, booking rules and class types remain yours to change.
settings.identity_slug_help: It appears in the URL. Changing it breaks links already shared.
settings.identity_timezone_help: It governs displayed hours and the cancellation window.
settings.identity_currency_help: It is frozen from the first payment onwards.
settings.rules_help: They apply to every class, unless a slot overrides them.
settings.rules_cancel_window_help: Minutes before the class, past which cancelling is no longer free.
settings.rules_max_upcoming_help: How many upcoming classes a member may hold.
settings.rules_visitor_capacity_help: Places held for members of partner boxes.
settings.hours_help: Local time of the box. A day without a slot is a closed day; a lunch break is two slots.
settings.places_help: A box may have several addresses; each one holds its rooms.
settings.places_empty: No address yet. Add the first one below.
settings.rooms_help: A room capacity caps the classes held in it.
settings.rooms_needs_location: Add an address first: a room always belongs to a place.
settings.types_help: The catalogue of what the box offers. The schedule builds on it.
settings.types_empty: No class type yet. Start with the WOD.
settings.types_name_en_help: Optional. Without it, the French name is shown in both languages.
settings.types_color_help: It colours the dot on the schedule; the name stays next to it.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
errors.profile_not_found: Profile not found. Sign in again.
errors.email_already_registered: An account already exists with this email address.
errors.email_immutable: Your email address is changed from your account settings.
errors.invitation_not_found: This invitation link is not valid.
errors.invitation_expired: This invitation has expired. Ask your box for a new one.
errors.invitation_already_used: This invitation has already been used. Ask your box for a new one.
errors.invitation_email_mismatch: This invitation is personal: sign in with the address it was sent to.
errors.already_member: You are already part of this box.
errors.membership_not_found: No active membership in this box.
errors.membership_suspended: Your access to this box is suspended. Contact your box.
errors.membership_revoked: Your access to this box was revoked. A new personal invitation is required.
errors.not_tenant_member: You are not an active member of this box.
errors.forbidden_role: Your role in this box does not allow this action.
errors.manager_cannot_grant_role: A manager can only grant the Member and Coach roles.
errors.manager_cannot_modify_admin: A manager cannot modify an owner or another manager.
errors.last_owner: A box always keeps at least one owner. Transfer ownership first.
errors.tenant_closed: This box is no longer accepting new members.
errors.tenant_slug_invalid: The URL name accepts only lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
errors.tenant_slug_taken: This URL name is already taken.
errors.tenant_quota_reached: Box limit reached for this account. Contact support.
errors.currency_locked: The currency can no longer be changed: accounting entries already exist.
errors.tenant_would_be_orphaned: This account is the sole owner of at least one box. Transfer ownership or close the box before deleting it.
errors.already_booked: Your spot in this class is already booked.
errors.booking_window_closed: Bookings are not open yet for this class.
errors.no_valid_entitlement: No valid membership or credit for this class.
errors.max_upcoming_bookings_reached: You have reached the maximum number of upcoming bookings.
errors.quota_exceeded: You have used up your quota for this period.
errors.append_only: This entry is final and cannot be modified.
